_published_faq.name: How do I add Eventfrog to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Eventfrog to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.eventfrog.net/mcp/v1.

_published_faq.name: Is Eventfrog MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of September 15, 2026, Eventfrog scores 0/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan does not yet meet ChatGPT publishing checks and does not yet meet Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Eventfrog MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Eventfrog provides these MCP tools: get_event, list_rubrics, and search_events.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Eventfrog?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Eventfrog in media-entertainment on the Manufact MCP catalog include Credits.fm, SceneF, HANKOOKILBO MCP, Ticketbox.vn, and drawnames.
Eventfrog does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.

_published_faq.name: Why is Eventfrog failing MCP readiness checks?

acceptedAnswer.text: Eventfrog scored 0/100 on the latest Manufact MCP publishing checklist, below the 70-point checklist threshold. The top failing check is MCP negotiation succeeds (v1/v2).
